paragraphs.text: With three years of IEC 62304 software development for medical devices, I am applying for your software engineer position.

At MedTech Exemple SAS, I brought infusion-pump software into IEC 62304 (Class B) compliance: development plan, requirements-to-test traceability and 240 automated unit tests. I also led the software risk analysis per ISO 14971 with the quality team, with 35 risk controls traced.
ACME Medical designs infusion pumps and Class IIb monitors, and your focus on continuous integration matches what I set up on GitLab CI, where release validation went from 3 days to 4 hours.
I would welcome the opportunity to discuss in an interview how I could contribute to your software teams.
